# API reference

163 tools in 23 categories. Every tool is listed with its parameters and a
worked example; the examples are the arguments the end-to-end suite sends to a real editor,
so they are executable rather than illustrative.

A client can register a subset — see [Trimming the tool list](../../README.md#trimming-the-tool-list).
The **core** column is what `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core` keeps.

## Every tool

| Tool | Category | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`add_animation_track`](animation.md#add_animation_track) | Animation | Add a track to an existing animation (property, method, or Bezier track) |
| [`add_audio_effect`](audio.md#add_audio_effect) | Audio | Add an audio effect (reverb, compressor, EQ, etc.) to an audio bus. Effects are applied in order. Fully undoable. |
| [`add_audio_player`](audio.md#add_audio_player) | Audio | Add an AudioStreamPlayer, AudioStreamPlayer2D, or AudioStreamPlayer3D node to the scene. The node plays audio on the specified bus. Call load_audio_file to assign a stream afterward. |
| [`add_blend_tree`](animation-tree.md#add_blend_tree) | AnimationTree | Set the tree_root of an AnimationTree to a new AnimationNodeBlendTree, optionally adding blend nodes |
| [`add_camera`](scene-3d.md#add_camera) | 3D scene | Add a Camera3D node to the current 3D scene with configurable projection, FOV or orthographic size, and clipping planes. Use take_screenshot with viewport 'camera' to see what it frames. |
| [`add_collision_shape`](physics.md#add_collision_shape) | Physics | Add a CollisionShape3D or CollisionShape2D node with a primitive shape resource. Typically added as a child of a physics body. |
| [`add_gridmap`](scene-3d.md#add_gridmap) | 3D scene | Add a GridMap node to the current 3D scene, optionally loading a MeshLibrary resource |
| [`add_keyframe`](animation.md#add_keyframe) | Animation | Add a keyframe to a track in an animation |
| [`add_light`](scene-3d.md#add_light) | 3D scene | Add a 3D light node (DirectionalLight3D, OmniLight3D, or SpotLight3D) to the current scene |
| [`add_mesh`](scene-3d.md#add_mesh) | 3D scene | Add a MeshInstance3D node with a primitive mesh (box, sphere, cylinder, plane, capsule, torus, quad, prism) to the current 3D scene |
| [`add_navigation_agent`](navigation.md#add_navigation_agent) | Navigation | Add a NavigationAgent3D or NavigationAgent2D to a parent node. The agent computes paths and steers its parent toward a target_position. Attach it to a CharacterBody or similar movement node. |
| [`add_navigation_region`](navigation.md#add_navigation_region) | Navigation | Add a NavigationRegion3D or NavigationRegion2D node with an empty navigation mesh/polygon. Call bake_navigation afterward to populate the walkable area from scene geometry. |
| [`add_node`](node.md#add_node) | Node | Add a new node as a child in the active scene (supports UndoRedo) |
| [`add_raycast`](physics.md#add_raycast) | Physics | Add a RayCast3D or RayCast2D node to the scene. The ray fires from the node's origin toward target_position in local space. |
| [`add_rigid_body`](physics.md#add_rigid_body) | Physics | Add a physics body node (RigidBody3D/2D, StaticBody3D/2D, CharacterBody3D/2D, AnimatableBody3D/2D) to the current scene |
| [`add_to_group`](node.md#add_to_group) | Node | Add a node to a group (supports UndoRedo) |
| [`add_transition`](animation-tree.md#add_transition) | AnimationTree | Add a transition between two states in an AnimationNodeStateMachine. Use 'Start' and 'End' for the built-in entry/exit nodes. |
| [`analyze_scene_complexity`](analysis.md#analyze_scene_complexity) | Analysis | Analyze a scene's structural complexity and return metrics: node count, max depth, number of scripted nodes, instanced sub-scenes, signal connections, unique external resources, and a frequency breakdown of node types. Uses the currently open scene when 'scene_path' is omitted. |
| [`assert_node_state`](testing.md#assert_node_state) | Testing / QA | Assert that one or more properties of a node in the currently open scene match expected values. Use the 'assertions' array for multiple checks, or 'property'+'expected' for a single check. Returns {passed: bool, assertions: [{property, expected, actual, passed}]}. |
| [`assign_material`](shader.md#assign_material) | Shader | Assign a ShaderMaterial to a node in the current scene. Provide either shader_path (creates a new in-memory ShaderMaterial, optionally saved with save_material_path) or material_path (loads an existing .tres ShaderMaterial). Works on GeometryInstance3D nodes (use surface_index) and CanvasItem nodes. Supports Ctrl+Z undo. |
| [`attach_script`](script.md#attach_script) | Script | Attach a GDScript to a node in the active scene (supports UndoRedo). Creates the file if it does not exist. |
| [`bake_navigation`](navigation.md#bake_navigation) | Navigation | Bake the navigation mesh or polygon for a NavigationRegion node. For 3D, scans MeshInstance3D children and builds a walkable mesh; for 2D, bakes from the polygon outline. Must have geometry in the region's subtree to produce a non-empty result. |
| [`bulk_rename`](batch.md#bulk_rename) | Batch / refactor | Rename nodes whose names match a pattern. In 'current_scene' scope, uses UndoRedo (Ctrl+Z supported). In 'all_scenes' scope, modifies and re-saves scene files directly (no UndoRedo). Use dry_run:true in all_scenes mode to preview changes before saving. |
| [`call_function`](runtime.md#call_function) | Runtime | Call a method on a node in the active scene and return the result |
| [`click_ui_element`](runtime.md#click_ui_element) | Runtime | Simulate a click on a UI Control node (calls press() for buttons or emits gui_input) |
| [`compare_screenshots`](testing.md#compare_screenshots) | Testing / QA | Compare two screenshot files pixel-by-pixel and report the difference ratio. Returns {diff_ratio, threshold, passed} where diff_ratio is the fraction of differing pixels [0.0–1.0]. Useful for visual regression testing — take a baseline screenshot, make changes, take another, then compare. |
| [`configure_bus`](audio.md#configure_bus) | Audio | Set volume, mute, solo, or send routing on an audio bus. At least one of volume_db, mute, solo, or send must be provided. Changes apply to the AudioServer immediately and are undoable. The 'Master' bus always exists and cannot have its send rerouted; other buses must be created in the Audio panel first. |
| [`configure_input_mapping`](input.md#configure_input_mapping) | Input | List, add, or remove Input Map actions and their key bindings |
| [`connect_signal`](node.md#connect_signal) | Node | Connect a signal from a source node to a method on a target node (supports UndoRedo) |
| [`convert_uid`](project.md#convert_uid) | Project | Convert between Godot UID (uid://...) and resource path (res://...) |
| [`create_animation_tree`](animation-tree.md#create_animation_tree) | AnimationTree | Create an AnimationTree node in the current scene and attach a tree root (state machine, blend tree, or blend space) |
| [`create_animation`](animation.md#create_animation) | Animation | Create a new animation in an AnimationPlayer node |
| [`create_particle_system`](particles.md#create_particle_system) | Particles | Add a GPUParticles3D or GPUParticles2D node to the scene. Creates an empty particle system — use set_particle_material or load_particle_preset to configure it. |
| [`create_resource`](resource.md#create_resource) | Resource | Create a new instance of any Godot ClassDB resource type and save it as a .tres file. The class must be a Resource subclass registered in ClassDB (e.g. 'Environment', 'AudioStreamWAV', 'StyleBoxFlat', 'Resource'). |
| [`create_scene`](scene.md#create_scene) | Scene | Create and save a new scene with a root node |
| [`create_script`](script.md#create_script) | Script | Create a new GDScript file with optional extends and class_name |
| [`create_shader`](shader.md#create_shader) | Shader | Create a new Godot shader file (.gdshader) with optional skeleton code. Optionally creates a companion ShaderMaterial .tres file. Returns an error if the file already exists unless overwrite is true. |
| [`create_state_machine`](animation-tree.md#create_state_machine) | AnimationTree | Set the tree_root of an AnimationTree to a new AnimationNodeStateMachine, optionally adding initial animation states |
| [`create_theme`](theme.md#create_theme) | Theme / UI | Create a new empty Theme resource and save it as a .tres file. Optionally set a default font and default font size. Returns an error if the file already exists unless overwrite is true. |
| [`cross_scene_update`](batch.md#cross_scene_update) | Batch / refactor | Update a property on all nodes of a given type across multiple scene files. Use dry_run:true to preview which nodes would be changed before committing. Note: scenes are instantiated and re-packed, bypassing UndoRedo. |
| [`delete_animation_tree_node`](animation-tree.md#delete_animation_tree_node) | AnimationTree | Delete a state from a StateMachine (state_name param), or remove the AnimationTree node itself from the scene (no state_name) |
| [`delete_animation`](animation.md#delete_animation) | Animation | Delete an animation or remove a track from an animation |
| [`delete_node`](node.md#delete_node) | Node | Delete a node and its children from the active scene (supports UndoRedo) |
| [`delete_scene`](scene.md#delete_scene) | Scene | Delete a scene file from the project |
| [`duplicate_node`](node.md#duplicate_node) | Node | Duplicate a node and all its children (supports UndoRedo) |
| [`edit_blend_space`](animation-tree.md#edit_blend_space) | AnimationTree | Add, remove, reposition, or list blend points in a BlendSpace1D or BlendSpace2D tree root |
| [`edit_resource`](resource.md#edit_resource) | Resource | Modify one or more properties of an existing resource file and save it to disk. Property values are type-coerced to match the resource's declared property types. Call read_resource first to see available property names and their current values. |
| [`edit_script`](script.md#edit_script) | Script | Edit a GDScript file: replace all content or a specific line range |
| [`edit_shader`](shader.md#edit_shader) | Shader | Replace or append to the source code of an existing .gdshader file. Changes take effect immediately — any node using a ShaderMaterial referencing this shader will recompile. |
| [`emit_signal`](runtime.md#emit_signal) | Runtime | Emit a signal on a node with optional arguments |
| [`erase_tile_cell`](tilemap.md#erase_tile_cell) | TileMap | Remove the tile at a specific cell position, leaving it empty. Fully undoable. |
| [`execute_script`](editor.md#execute_script) | Editor | Execute a GDScript snippet in the editor context (runs as EditorScript). Returns whatever _run() returns as 'result', and the text passed to mcp_print(...) as 'output'. await is supported: the call waits for the coroutine to finish. |
| [`export_project`](export.md#export_project) | Export | Export the Godot project using a named export preset. Runs 'godot --headless --export-release <preset> <output>' (or --export-debug when debug=true). The preset must already be configured in Project > Export. output_path overrides the preset's configured export_path; if both are omitted the tool returns an error. |
| [`fill_tiles`](tilemap.md#fill_tiles) | TileMap | Fill a rectangular region of a TileMap with the same tile. All cells from from_coords to to_coords (inclusive) are set to the given tile. Maximum 10,000 cells per call. Fully undoable. |
| [`find_by_group`](batch.md#find_by_group) | Batch / refactor | Search all scenes for nodes that belong to a specific node group. Returns a list of {scene, node_path, node_name, node_type} matches. |
| [`find_by_node_type`](batch.md#find_by_node_type) | Batch / refactor | Search all scenes in the project for nodes of a given built-in class (e.g. Sprite2D, MeshInstance3D). For custom GDScript classes use find_by_script instead. Returns a list of {scene, node_path, node_name, node_type} matches. |
| [`find_by_script`](batch.md#find_by_script) | Batch / refactor | Search all scenes for nodes that have a specific GDScript file attached. Returns a list of {scene, node_path, node_name, node_type} matches. |
| [`find_dependencies`](batch.md#find_dependencies) | Batch / refactor | List the resources that a given resource or scene depends on. With recursive:true, returns the full transitive dependency tree. |
| [`find_unused_resources`](analysis.md#find_unused_resources) | Analysis | Find raw asset files (images, audio, fonts, 3D models) in the project that are not referenced by any scene or resource file. Useful for cleaning up orphaned assets. Note: assets only referenced via GDScript load() at runtime cannot be detected statically. |
| [`focus_editor`](editor.md#focus_editor) | Editor | Bring the Godot editor window to the foreground |
| [`get_3d_scene_info`](scene-3d.md#get_3d_scene_info) | 3D scene | Scan the current scene and return all Node3D nodes with their type, transform, and type-specific properties (mesh, camera FOV, light color, etc.) |
| [`get_animation_info`](animation.md#get_animation_info) | Animation | Get detailed info about an animation: tracks, keyframes, length, loop mode |
| [`get_code_metrics`](analysis.md#get_code_metrics) | Analysis | Compute code quality metrics for one or more GDScript files: line counts (total/code/comment/blank), function count, class count, signal count, export count, branch count (if/elif/match), loop count (for/while), and comment ratio. Provide 'script_path' for a single file, 'directory' to scan a folder, or omit both to scan the entire project. |
| [`get_editor_state`](editor.md#get_editor_state) | Editor | Get the current editor state: active scene, selected nodes, current main screen panel |
| [`get_editor_version`](editor.md#get_editor_version) | Editor | Get the current Godot editor version information |
| [`get_error_log`](editor.md#get_error_log) | Editor | Get recent errors and warnings from the newest Godot log file. The editor process writes no log — this reads what a running project logged, so play the scene first to see whether it starts clean. |
| [`get_game_state`](runtime.md#get_game_state) | Runtime | Get the current game state: running/paused, active scene, FPS, time scale |
| [`get_memory_usage`](profiling.md#get_memory_usage) | Profiling | Return a breakdown of Godot's memory consumption: static allocator (used/peak in bytes and MB), render memory (VRAM, textures, buffers), and optionally a sample of currently cached resource paths. Useful for spotting memory leaks or unexpected resource retention. |
| [`get_navigation_info`](navigation.md#get_navigation_info) | Navigation | Get navigation configuration for a specific node, or scan the entire scene and return all NavigationRegion and NavigationAgent nodes with their layer and mesh settings. |
| [`get_navigation_path`](navigation.md#get_navigation_path) | Navigation | Query the navigation server for a walkable path between two positions. Returns an ordered array of waypoints. Requires at least one NavigationRegion with a baked mesh in the scene; returns an empty path if no walkable route exists. |
| [`get_node_children`](node.md#get_node_children) | Node | Get all immediate children of a node |
| [`get_node_groups`](node.md#get_node_groups) | Node | Get all groups a node belongs to |
| [`get_node_parent`](node.md#get_node_parent) | Node | Get the parent node of a given node |
| [`get_node_properties`](node.md#get_node_properties) | Node | Get editor-visible properties and their current values for a node. Pass 'names' to read specific properties — a bare node reports ~40 of them. |
| [`get_node_signals`](node.md#get_node_signals) | Node | Get all signals defined on a node, including existing connections |
| [`get_node_tree_runtime`](runtime.md#get_node_tree_runtime) | Runtime | Get the scene tree with runtime information (script state, visible, groups) |
| [`get_particle_info`](particles.md#get_particle_info) | Particles | Get the current configuration of a GPUParticles node: amount, lifetime, emit state, and ParticleProcessMaterial properties (direction, velocity, color, emission shape, gradient presence). |
| [`get_performance_metrics`](runtime.md#get_performance_metrics) | Runtime | Get engine performance monitors: FPS, memory, draw calls, node count |
| [`get_performance_monitors`](profiling.md#get_performance_monitors) | Profiling | Return current values for all Godot Performance monitors grouped by category: time (FPS, frame/physics/navigation ms), memory (static bytes/peak), render (objects, primitives, draw calls, VRAM), physics_2d/3d (active objects, collision pairs, islands), audio (output latency), navigation (maps, regions, agents, polygons). Use 'category' to request a single group. |
| [`get_physics_info`](physics.md#get_physics_info) | Physics | Get physics properties of a node: collision layer/mask, body type, mass, velocity (RigidBody), raycast state, and child CollisionShape details |
| [`get_project_autoloads`](resource.md#get_project_autoloads) | Resource | Return all autoload singletons registered in the project settings (reads ProjectSettings). Each entry includes name, script/scene path, and whether it is instantiated as a node. Use set_autoload to add or remove entries. |
| [`get_project_info`](project.md#get_project_info) | Project | Get basic project information: name, version, Godot version, path, main scene |
| [`get_project_metadata`](project.md#get_project_metadata) | Project | Get project metadata: renderer, viewport size, gravity, OS features |
| [`get_project_settings`](project.md#get_project_settings) | Project | Get one or all project settings. Pass setting_path for a specific setting (e.g. 'physics/2d/default_gravity'), omit for common defaults |
| [`get_scene_info`](scene.md#get_scene_info) | Scene | Get metadata about a scene: root type, node count, whether it is open |
| [`get_scene_tree`](scene.md#get_scene_tree) | Scene | Get the scene tree of the currently edited scene or a specific scene file |
| [`get_script_info`](script.md#get_script_info) | Script | Get metadata about a GDScript: class name, base class, methods, signals, properties |
| [`get_shader_info`](shader.md#get_shader_info) | Shader | Return the source code, shader type, and uniform list for a shader. Can inspect via a .gdshader file path, a ShaderMaterial .tres file path, or a node path. When called with a node_path or material_path, also returns the current value of each uniform parameter. |
| [`get_signal_connections`](runtime.md#get_signal_connections) | Runtime | List all signal connections on a node (outgoing and incoming) |
| [`get_state_machine_info`](animation-tree.md#get_state_machine_info) | AnimationTree | Get detailed info about an AnimationTree: tree_root type, states, transitions, blend points |
| [`get_template_info`](export.md#get_template_info) | Export | Return information about installed Godot export templates for the current engine version. Shows the template directory path, whether templates are installed, and which platform entries are present. If templates are missing, returns instructions for installing them. |
| [`get_test_report`](testing.md#get_test_report) | Testing / QA | Return the most recent test report produced by run_automated_tests. Returns the full report dict including per-file and per-method results, or an error if no report has been generated yet. |
| [`get_theme_info`](theme.md#get_theme_info) | Theme / UI | Return all overrides defined in a Theme file, organized by Control type. Shows colors, fonts, font sizes, integer constants, and StyleBox names/types. Use this to inspect a theme before modifying it. |
| [`get_tilemap_info`](tilemap.md#get_tilemap_info) | TileMap | Get overview information about a TileMap node: layer count and names, used cell counts per layer, bounding rectangle of all placed tiles, and TileSet assignment. |
| [`get_tileset_info`](tilemap.md#get_tileset_info) | TileMap | Get information about the TileSet assigned to a TileMap: tile size, tile shape (square/isometric/hex), and all sources with their atlas textures and tile counts. Use this to discover valid source_id and atlas_coords values before placing tiles. |
| [`get_variable_value`](runtime.md#get_variable_value) | Runtime | Get the current value of a node property or exported variable |
| [`inspect_node_at_runtime`](runtime.md#inspect_node_at_runtime) | Runtime | Get full property snapshot of a node (current values, not just schema) |
| [`instantiate_scene`](scene.md#instantiate_scene) | Scene | Instantiate a scene as a child node inside the active scene (supports UndoRedo) |
| [`list_autoloads`](runtime.md#list_autoloads) | Runtime | List all autoload singletons defined in the project |
| [`list_export_presets`](export.md#list_export_presets) | Export | List all export presets defined in the project's export_presets.cfg. Returns name, platform, runnable flag, configured export path, and per-preset options for each preset. |
| [`list_loaded_resources`](runtime.md#list_loaded_resources) | Runtime | List resource files in the project filtered by type or path prefix |
| [`list_open_scenes`](scene.md#list_open_scenes) | Scene | List all scenes currently open in the editor |
| [`list_project_files`](project.md#list_project_files) | Project | List files in the project (optionally filtered by folder path or file extension) |
| [`listen_to_signal`](runtime.md#listen_to_signal) | Runtime | Wait for a signal to fire on a node (async, with timeout) |
| [`load_audio_file`](audio.md#load_audio_file) | Audio | Assign an audio stream resource to an AudioStreamPlayer node. The file must already exist in the Godot project. Supports .ogg, .wav, and .mp3 files. |
| [`load_particle_preset`](particles.md#load_particle_preset) | Particles | Apply a built-in particle effect preset to a GPUParticles node. Replaces the current process material, amount, and lifetime with preset values. Fully undoable. |
| [`move_node`](node.md#move_node) | Node | Move a node to a different parent or reorder it within the same parent (supports UndoRedo) |
| [`navigate_to_node`](runtime.md#navigate_to_node) | Runtime | Select and scroll to a node in the editor's Scene panel |
| [`open_editor_settings`](editor.md#open_editor_settings) | Editor | Get current Godot editor settings as a dictionary (optionally filter by prefix) |
| [`open_scene`](scene.md#open_scene) | Scene | Open a scene file in the Godot editor |
| [`orphaned_resources`](batch.md#orphaned_resources) | Batch / refactor | Find resources in the project that are not referenced by any scene or other resource. Useful for cleaning up unused assets. By default scans .tres, .res, and .gdshader files. |
| [`pause_game`](runtime.md#pause_game) | Runtime | Pause the running game (sets SceneTree.paused = true) |
| [`play_audio`](audio.md#play_audio) | Audio | Start playback on an AudioStreamPlayer node. Works in the editor — audio will be audible if the node has a stream assigned. Fully undoable. |
| [`play_scene`](scene.md#play_scene) | Scene | Run a scene in the Godot player |
| [`query_tile_cell`](tilemap.md#query_tile_cell) | TileMap | Get the tile data at a specific cell position. Returns source_id, atlas_coords, and alternative ID. Returns is_empty: true for cells with no tile placed. |
| [`read_resource`](resource.md#read_resource) | Resource | Load a Godot resource file (.tres, .res, or any ResourceLoader-supported path) and return all its stored properties. Use this to inspect a resource before editing it. |
| [`read_script`](script.md#read_script) | Script | Read the full source code of a GDScript file |
| [`record_gameplay`](runtime.md#record_gameplay) | Runtime | Record gameplay input events for a duration (game must be running) |
| [`record_input_sequence`](input.md#record_input_sequence) | Input | Record all keyboard and mouse events for a given duration, then return the sequence |
| [`record_test`](testing.md#record_test) | Testing / QA | Start or stop recording a test interaction sequence, or add individual events to an in-progress recording. Use action='start' to begin, action='add_event' to append an event dict, action='stop' to finish. The returned 'events' array from action='stop' can be passed to replay_test. |
| [`refactor_signals`](batch.md#refactor_signals) | Batch / refactor | Rename signal handler method connections across scene files. Finds all signal connections that call 'old_method' and rewires them to 'new_method'. Use dry_run:true to preview changes. Note: bypasses UndoRedo. |
| [`reload_scripts`](script.md#reload_scripts) | Script | Reload all GDScripts in the editor (equivalent to editor Reload Scripts action) |
| [`remove_from_group`](node.md#remove_from_group) | Node | Remove a node from a group (supports UndoRedo) |
| [`rename_node`](node.md#rename_node) | Node | Rename a node in the active scene (supports UndoRedo) |
| [`replay_gameplay`](runtime.md#replay_gameplay) | Runtime | Replay a previously recorded gameplay session (game must be running) |
| [`replay_input_sequence`](input.md#replay_input_sequence) | Input | Replay a recorded or manually defined input sequence |
| [`replay_test`](testing.md#replay_test) | Testing / QA | Replay a list of recorded test events into the editor. Supports event types: key_press (keycode, ctrl, shift, alt), mouse_click (x, y, button), mouse_move (x, y), action (action_name), wait (seconds). Returns {replayed, total, errors, status}. |
| [`resume_game`](runtime.md#resume_game) | Runtime | Resume the paused game (sets SceneTree.paused = false) |
| [`run_automated_tests`](testing.md#run_automated_tests) | Testing / QA | Run GDScript test files under a given directory. Each .gd file is loaded and every method whose name starts with 'test_' is called. A method passes if it returns true (or nothing); it fails if it returns false or a dict with 'error'. Returns a summary with per-file and per-method pass/fail counts. |
| [`save_resource`](resource.md#save_resource) | Resource | Load a resource and re-save it. When dest_path is omitted, force-resaves to the same path (useful to upgrade resource format or flush pending changes). When dest_path is provided, copies/converts the resource to that path. |
| [`save_scene`](scene.md#save_scene) | Scene | Save the scene currently open in the editor to disk. Node mutations (add_node, set_node_property, add_mesh, ...) only change the in-memory scene — call this to commit them. |
| [`search_files`](project.md#search_files) | Project | Search for files by name or text content |
| [`search_in_scripts`](script.md#search_in_scripts) | Script | Search for a text pattern in all .gd files, returns matches with file path and line number |
| [`select_node_in_editor`](editor.md#select_node_in_editor) | Editor | Select one or more nodes in the editor's Scene panel |
| [`set_active_state`](animation-tree.md#set_active_state) | AnimationTree | Enable/disable an AnimationTree (active param), or set the initial/entry state of a StateMachine by adding a Start→state transition (state_name param) |
| [`set_autoload`](resource.md#set_autoload) | Resource | Add, update, or remove an autoload singleton in the project settings. Changes take effect in the editor immediately. Use action 'remove' to delete an existing autoload; action 'add' (default) to add or overwrite one. |
| [`set_collision_layer`](physics.md#set_collision_layer) | Physics | Set the collision_layer bitmask on a CollisionObject (PhysicsBody or Area). Determines which physics layer(s) the object occupies. |
| [`set_collision_mask`](physics.md#set_collision_mask) | Physics | Set the collision_mask bitmask on a CollisionObject or RayCast. Determines which layer(s) the object detects collisions with. |
| [`set_easing`](animation.md#set_easing) | Animation | Set the easing/transition curve of a keyframe in an animation track |
| [`set_environment`](scene-3d.md#set_environment) | 3D scene | Create or configure the WorldEnvironment node: background mode/color, ambient light, fog, and tonemapping. Finds an existing WorldEnvironment in the scene or creates a new one. |
| [`set_game_speed`](runtime.md#set_game_speed) | Runtime | Set Engine.time_scale to speed up or slow down the game (1.0 = normal) |
| [`set_navigation_layer`](navigation.md#set_navigation_layer) | Navigation | Set the navigation_layers bitmask on a NavigationRegion, NavigationAgent, or NavigationObstacle node. Agents only traverse regions on matching layers, enabling multi-floor or multi-group navigation. |
| [`set_node_property`](node.md#set_node_property) | Node | Set a property on a node. Godot types can be passed as strings: 'Vector2(10, 20)', '#ff0000', 'Color(1,0,0)' (supports UndoRedo) |
| [`set_particle_gradient`](particles.md#set_particle_gradient) | Particles | Assign a color gradient to a particle system's material. The gradient controls color or initial color over each particle's lifetime. Requires the node to already have a ParticleProcessMaterial (call set_particle_material first). |
| [`set_particle_material`](particles.md#set_particle_material) | Particles | Create or update the ParticleProcessMaterial on a GPUParticles node. Controls particle physics: direction, velocity, gravity, scale, color, and emission shape. |
| [`set_project_setting`](project.md#set_project_setting) | Project | Set a project setting and save project.godot |
| [`set_shader_param`](shader.md#set_shader_param) | Shader | Set the value of a uniform parameter on a node's ShaderMaterial. Supports Ctrl+Z undo. Value types: number (float/int), boolean, [x,y] array (vec2), [x,y,z] array (vec3), [r,g,b,a] array (Color), '#rrggbb' hex string (Color), or 'res://...' path (sampler2D Texture). |
| [`set_stylebox`](theme.md#set_stylebox) | Theme / UI | Create and assign a StyleBox to a named slot for a specific Control type in a Theme file. Use 'flat' for colored/bordered boxes, 'line' for a single divider line, 'empty' for invisible padding. Saves the theme immediately. |
| [`set_theme_color`](theme.md#set_theme_color) | Theme / UI | Set a named color override for a specific Control type in a Theme file. Common examples: set 'font_color' on 'Label', 'font_hover_color' on 'Button'. Saves the theme immediately. |
| [`set_theme_constant`](theme.md#set_theme_constant) | Theme / UI | Set an integer constant override for a specific Control type in a Theme file. Constants control spacing, icon sizes, and other integer properties. Saves the theme immediately. |
| [`set_theme_font`](theme.md#set_theme_font) | Theme / UI | Assign a font resource to a named font slot for a specific Control type in a Theme file. Optionally set the font size for that slot. Saves the theme immediately. |
| [`set_tile_cell`](tilemap.md#set_tile_cell) | TileMap | Set a tile at a specific cell position in a TileMap layer. Use get_tileset_info first to discover valid source_id and atlas_coords values. Fully undoable. |
| [`set_variable_value`](runtime.md#set_variable_value) | Runtime | Set the value of a node property or exported variable at runtime |
| [`simulate_key_press`](input.md#simulate_key_press) | Input | Inject a keyboard event into the running game |
| [`simulate_mouse_click`](input.md#simulate_mouse_click) | Input | Inject a mouse button event at a screen position |
| [`simulate_mouse_move`](input.md#simulate_mouse_move) | Input | Inject a mouse motion event to move the cursor to a screen position |
| [`stop_audio`](audio.md#stop_audio) | Audio | Stop playback on an AudioStreamPlayer node. If the node was playing, undo will restart playback from the beginning. Fully undoable. |
| [`stop_scene`](scene.md#stop_scene) | Scene | Stop the currently running scene |
| [`take_screenshot`](editor.md#take_screenshot) | Editor | Capture a screenshot and save it to a file. Use viewport 'camera' to render the open scene through one of its own cameras — that is the view the player gets, and the only way to check an orthographic camera's framing. The running game's own window cannot be captured: it is a separate OS process. |
| [`trace_signal_flow`](analysis.md#trace_signal_flow) | Analysis | List all signal connections in a scene showing source node, signal name, target node, and handler method. Optionally filter to connections involving a specific node path. Uses the currently open scene when 'scene_path' is omitted. |
| [`trigger_input_action`](input.md#trigger_input_action) | Input | Press or release a named Input action (e.g. 'ui_accept', 'jump') |
| [`validate_shader`](shader.md#validate_shader) | Shader | Validate a Godot shader for structural correctness: checks for a valid 'shader_type' declaration and whether Godot recognizes the declared mode. Note: full GLSL syntax errors inside function bodies are not detectable via GDScript — check Godot's Output panel for GPU compile errors after assigning the shader to a material. |
| [`validate_syntax`](script.md#validate_syntax) | Script | Validate GDScript syntax without saving. Pass source code or a file path. |
